title.narrative: Welthungerhilfe Anticipatory Humanitarian Action Facility (WAHAFA) Kenya Build Project

description.narrative: Objective of the action: NGO members of the Humanitarian Assistance Coordinating Committee (KOA) and their local humanitarian partners (LHP) are orientated on WAHAFA application, approval, and implementation procedures concerning access to technical and financial support for engaging in anticipatory humanitarian action.

This 'builld' project has several participant cohorts. Firstly, since it targets to entrench The Federal Foreign Office within the NGO sector, one participant cohort will inculde actors, including NGOs that will be supported in variuos ways to enable them undertake anticipation work in the country. Other participants will include actors within the government setting - both the national and county/regional governments. Key partcicipants will include the National disaster operation centre( NDOC), the National Drought Mnagement Authority( NDMA), The Kenya Meteorologicaldepartment( KMD) and the variousrelevant departments at the county level. At the commuity level, deliberate efforts will be made to ensure inclusivity. In this case, it is recognized that vulnerable groups such as children, girls, boys, the elderly, the internally displaced/refugees and mothers are affected differently by extreme disaster events. In this case, proper analyses will be supported to ensure the best anticipation of these groups as well as the design of the most- fit- for purpose actions. Since pastoralism accounts for over 70% of the livelihoods of the populations in these regions, pastoralists are a key participant group.The total number of participants will come to : 21667

This project aims at anchoring the anticipatory actions approach in Kenya. Onboarding the learnings from previous anticipatory work by WHH and other actors, WHH will play a facilitative role within the community of actors to prepare them to undertake anticipation actions in the country. This 'build' project will be a preparatory project for future implementation of 'fuel' projects which will be the implementation of the early action protocols. Capacity assessments/developemnt of existing and potential actors will be undertaken. Further developments on disaster forecasting where the drought monitoring and trigger dashboard developed under previous initiatives will be further developed to adopt a multi-hazard approach focussing on drought, floods and to alimited extend, conflicts.
